title: Job
description: Adds a durable job definition to a service module, with a spec that fails until run() and onDrain() are implemented. The action that starts it is an action of kind job.

name.description: The job type, namespace.name (for example queues.purge-many).

module.description: The service module that owns the job (svc-admin or admin). It must exist: create it with the service-module generator.

resumable.description: Whether the job continues from its last checkpoint after an interruption.
